definitions.explanation: The date until which a food product is expected to retain its best quality and taste when stored properly. Products may still be safe to eat after this date.

examples.japanese: {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦してから→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I check the best-before date before buying.

examples.japanese: {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れている→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The best-before date is until next month.

examples.japanese: {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くなっている→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Products near their best-before date are discounted.

examples.japanese: {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎても→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べられなくなる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦わけではない→わけ：01095_wake⟧。
examples.english: Just because the best-before date has passed doesn't mean the food is immediately inedible.

notes:
COMPOUND: {賞味|しょうみ} (appreciation of taste) + ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (time limit)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (best-before date expires)
- {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦{内|ない}→内：09853_nai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (eat within the best-before date)
- {賞味期限|しょうみきげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧ (best-before date is approaching)

DISTINCTION: {賞味期限|しょうみきげん} (best-before) refers to quality, while ⟦{消費期限|しょうひきげん}→消費期限：06077_shouhikigen⟧ (use-by) refers to safety. Products past their {賞味期限|しょうみきげん} may still be safe but may have reduced quality.
